mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment (payment_id, match_id, payer_user_id, club_id, application_type, club_member_ids, unit_amount, seat_count, total_amount, refunded_amount, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{paymentId}, #{matchId}, #{payerUserId}, #{clubId}, #{applicationType}, #{clubMemberIds}, #{unitAmount}, #{seatCount}, #{totalAmount}, 0, 'READY', #{createdAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM payment WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE payment SET status = 'REFUNDED', refunded_amount = total_amount, fail_reason = #{failReason}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND status = 'READY'

UPDATE payment SET status = CASE WHEN refunded_amount + #{amount} >= total_amount THEN 'REFUNDED' ELSE 'PARTIAL_REFUNDED' END, refunded_amount = refunded_amount + #{amount}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND status IN ('PAID', 'PARTIAL_REFUNDED') AND refunded_amount + #{amount} <= total_amount
mapper.select: SELECT receipt_no FROM match_application WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} ORDER BY application_id LIMIT 1
